anyJob.q: Does it work for any job?
anyJob.a: Yes. The example on this page is a software job, but {{brand}} reads whatever posting you paste, in any field: sales, healthcare, logistics, administration, teaching. The requirements come from that posting, not from a fixed list.

reads.q: What does {{brand}} read from my CV?
reads.a: The text layer of your PDF, the same one an applicant tracking system (ATS) reads. If the PDF is a scan with no text, we tell you, and it doesn't use up any of your analyses.

score.q: Do I get a score for how well I match?
score.a: No. You get a verdict (weak, partial or strong fit) counted from the requirements you meet, and you can check that count row by row. The scores are something else: the quality of your CV on its own, three of its readings, and your interview.

listens.q: Does anyone listen to my interview?
listens.a: No. It's practice, just for you: the interviewer is an AI, no one reviews the call, and no one will contact you. The transcript is only used to put together your feedback.

afterwards.q: What happens to my CV afterwards?
afterwards.a: It's kept in private storage for as long as its analysis exists. Delete the analysis, and the PDF and its interviews are deleted with it.

language.q: Which languages does it work in?
language.a: The app is in English and Spanish. The interview can be in either one: the room suggests the language of the posting, and you can change it before you start.

cancel.a: Any time, from your account. Pro stays active until the end of the period you paid for, and interviews from packs you bought never expire.
